# NEON 21

> NEON 21 (霓虹21号) is a free, single-file HTML5 Canvas brick-breaker (Arkanoid-style) game with a cyber-casino visual theme. It runs entirely in the browser with no download, registration, or real-money gambling. Players move a neon paddle to bounce an energy ball, shatter playing-card bricks, collect virtual chip power-ups, and chase high scores. Three virtual chips = three lives.

## Key facts
- Type: Arcade / Brick Breaker / Casual, single-player
- Platform: Web browser (PC + mobile), HTML5 Canvas
- Cost: Free, no ads paywall, no in-app purchases, no real money
- Controls: Arrow keys / A-D (desktop); drag on canvas (mobile); Space or tap to launch ball
- Scoring: brick base points, combo multiplier, gold-edge bricks, 5 power-ups (double score, widen paddle, multi-ball, shield, extra life)
- High score: stored in browser localStorage only, never uploaded
- Accessibility: keyboard + touch, prefers-reduced-motion respected, skip link, semantic HTML
- No real gambling: virtual chips are score only
